events.name: onPlayerSpawnFor
events.doc: Triggered when a player is spawned for another player (streaming in).

params.name: spawn_id
params.doc: Player id spawned for the receiver.

events.name: onPlayerUnspawnFor
events.doc: Triggered when a player is unspawned for another player (streaming out).

params.name: spawn_id
params.doc: Player id removed for the receiver.

events.name: onPlayerHit
events.doc: Triggered when a player is hit.

events.name: onInit
events.doc: Triggered once when the Gothic engine initializes.

events.name: onExit
events.doc: Triggered when the Gothic engine is exiting.

events.name: onRender
events.doc: Triggered each frame when the game renders.

events.name: onTime
events.doc: Triggered each time the game time minute passes.

events.name: onWeatherChange
events.doc: Triggered when weather changes.

events.name: onKeyDown
events.doc: Triggered when a key is pressed.

events.name: onKeyUp
events.doc: Triggered when a key is released.

events.name: onMouseDown
events.doc: Triggered when a mouse button is pressed.

events.name: onMouseUp
events.doc: Triggered when a mouse button is released.

events.name: onMouseMove
events.doc: Triggered when the mouse cursor is moved.

events.name: onMouseWheel
events.doc: Triggered when the mouse wheel is scrolled.

events.name: onOpenInventory
events.doc: Triggered when the user opens the inventory.

events.name: onCloseInventory
events.doc: Triggered when the user closes the inventory.

events.name: onInventorySlotChange
events.doc: Triggered when the selected inventory slot changes.

events.name: onWorldChange
events.doc: Triggered when the client requests a world change.

events.name: onWorldEnter
events.doc: Triggered when the active world is loaded and the hero is present in it.

events.name: onEquip
events.doc: Triggered when the hero equips an item.

events.name: onDropItem
events.doc: Triggered when the hero drops an item.

events.name: onTakeItem
events.doc: Triggered when the hero takes an item from the ground.

params.name: synchronized
params.doc: True when pickup is synchronized with the server.

events.name: onUseItem
events.doc: Triggered when the hero uses, interacts with, opens, or consumes an item.

events.name: onUnequip
events.doc: Triggered when the hero unequips an item.

events.name: onPlayerCreate
events.doc: Triggered when a player object is created locally.

events.name: onPlayerDestroy
events.doc: Triggered when a local player object is destroyed.

events.name: onPlayerMessage
events.doc: Triggered when a chat message is received locally.

events.name: onPlayerRespawn
events.doc: Triggered when a player respawns after death.

params.name: id
params.doc: The id of the respawned player.

events.name: onPlayerSpawn
events.doc: Triggered when a player is spawned into the world.

params.name: id
params.doc: The id of the spawned player.

events.name: onPlayerDead
events.doc: Triggered when a player or NPC dies.

params.name: id
params.doc: The id of the player who died.

events.name: onPlayerChangePing
events.doc: Triggered when the client receives a ping update for a player.
